Macrons

Consonantal i

Kitchen, meals & drinks

boil verb

be boiling

classical

ferveō, fervēre, ferbuī

verb, second conjugation, intransitive

boil or be very hot

The e before ō is short; it is long in the infinitive fervēre.

Examples

  • Aqua fervet.

    The water is boiling.composed

See also bring to the boil, cook, steam, kettle.

SourcesLewis & Short: ferveo

The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
